[LSIG.1.5.1] `integral` is the time-weighted integral of a rate slot, using
the rectangle rule over the piecewise-constant fact model:

$\mathit{integral}(\mathit{window}) = \int x(\tau)\,d\tau \approx \sum_i x_i \, (t_{i+1} - t_i)$

The most recent sample is held to the query time `t`, contributing
`xₙ × (t − tₙ)`. If slot `x` has units `U` and time is in seconds,
`integral` has units `U·s` (a flow rate in L/s integrated over 1_h yields
litres).
